stated_assumptions: An item absent from a clip or follow action keeps its initial value; a present value inside the stated ranges is kept as read apart from the opening corrections, and a chance outside 0 to 100 is kept as read until the follow-chance correction.
The opening corrections run for every clip read from a document, after any conversion.
An older document is converted by every conversion step above its suffix number, in increasing order, before its values are read.
The macOS arm64 build computes the extracted-execution values as the x86_64 build does. Every case with that label depends on it.
Converting the fixtures' other content (tracks, mixers, notes, sample reference, scenes) from 12.0_12117 and 11.0_405 does not refuse the document. Cases CLIP-LAUNCH-041 to 049 depend on it.

reviewers: separate review agent (Claude Opus 5.5) in a coordinator-launched handoff-review context; not the author; will not implement
findings: RVC2-01 medium: REQ-015 to 018 were worded as computations that launching uses (press beat, launch-boundary, song position, a Global clip 'uses' the song's time signature) and could be read as launch timing; narrowed: rounded_beat and grid-boundary, stated not to be launch timing, boundary not stated to be a launch's start, value cases not launch cases; no computed value changed

RVC2-02 low: the global argument was called the set's stored GlobalQuantisation, which could state which global value a launch uses; narrowed to values on the stored items' scale, and which global value, time signatures and grid a launch uses excluded; selection static-derived from the clip-grid function
RVC2-03 low: for a follow time outside 0 to below 1,000,000 only the held value was excluded; whether the document opens is now excluded too, since a later opening step was not traced
